These notes were distilled from earlier work in this repository that passed verification. Follow them unless the code or CHANGELOG.md shows they no longer hold.
- [at-0001] Raise BillingError with stable snake_case codes: Reject invalid input by raising BillingError(code, detail) from ledgerly.errors with a stable snake_case code such as "invalid_state", "invalid_quantity" or "negative_amount", and put the offending value in the message.
  (learned from task E02 on ledgerly 1.0.0; relied on 1x, 0 passed, 1 failed)
- [at-0006] Refunds above 500.00 need approved_by: Support-initiated refunds and credits above 500.00 require a second approver per finance policy FIN-2026-03: accept keyword-only `approved_by=None` and raise `BillingError("approval_required")` when the amount exceeds the threshold and no approver is given; amounts at or below 500.00 need no approval.
  (learned from task E04 on ledgerly 1.0.0; source FIN-2026-03; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
- [at-0005] Money-moving functions take keyword-only idempotency_key: Every function that moves money or changes a payment, credit or invoice balance must accept keyword-only `idempotency_key=None` and check it first, before any validation: scan `ledgerly.audit.events()` for an entry with the same key and return the original result (the same record) without reapplying. Pass `idempotency_key` into the `audit.record(...)` entry.
  (learned from task E04 on ledgerly 1.0.0; source INC-204; relied on 0x, 0 passed, 0 failed)
